detailed_descriptions_html.en:
★ The true sequel to the fantasy RPG, False Myth ★

A lengthy fantasy work by the Japanese developer "Fudashitatei", this game is themed around "fusing traditional RPG elements with multiple beautiful female companions", delivering the most authentic JRPG experience to players!

The sequel continues the charm of its predecessor while significantly enhancing the 'Encounter x Story x Combat' experience. It also includes a "Previous Story Recap" and "Glossaries" to ensure new players can easily understand the world and its setting.

The protagonist, Rouge, was once a nimble female assassin. However, due to the effects of an injected poison, she was transformed into a man.

With a naturally kind heart, he always steps forward to help whenever he encounters young girls in peril—

And through these repeated encounters, he gradually begins a captivating love story with his companions.

This is a story concerning the 'Heart,' woven by Rouge and his many heroines.

★ Authentic RPG! Dynamic side-scrolling combat with a complete system evolution ★

Partner Linkage! Spectacular Magic! Stealth Assassinations!

Utilize your partners and tactics to defeat enemies, and rely on strategy to overcome various difficult challenges.

★ Voiced! Making the narrative more immersive ★

The False Myth series is add voiced for the first time, featuring six characters and six voice actors.

Through the delicate performances of professional voice actors, the emotions and souls of the characters become even more vivid.

★ Characters ★

★ Features ★

  • Enjoy a wealth of mini-games, including fishing, racing, treasure hunting, and raffles.

  • An absolutely gripping adventure spanning over 600,000 words, culminating in a Happy Ending.

  • Five heroines. You can date any of them individually. This is the ultimate pure-love romance story.

  • In-depth game content. A secret post-game dungeon will be unlocked after clearing the main storyline.

  • Controller support, offering two switchable modes: "JRPG Style" and "International Style".

★ Story ★

The setting of the previous work: The territory of Rylan

Rouge will accompany Nagi on the journey to the Great Temple of Valdia.

However, along the way, they ran into a mysterious organization attacking a young girl.

With his powerful fighting abilities, Rouge saved the girl. But...

The young girl, who introduced herself as Sylphina, was highly unusual.

No matter what was said or done to her, her expression never changed. She was like a doll devoid of sanity.

Unable to simply leave the girl alone, Rouge decided to take her under his protection...

A lost heart, a yearning heart, an unchanging heart...

To protect all of this, a new battle is about to begin!
